Needs changes before merge.

The alias uses the existing checked Solidcraft importer. The native dialog and viewport drops use the same extension list. No goldens changed. No `.nc` or `.cl` files changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4676`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the native Model Open filter change. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

Safety checks:

This review used the safety tier because the alias changes geometry import routing. I repeated two mutations in the review worktree. I restored each file after the check. The final worktree had no tracked changes.

1. I restored upstream `crates/app/src/geometry/import/mod.rs`. All three `solidcraft_extension_` pins failed with exit code 101. The route pin returned `Unsupported("part.solidcraft")`. The two MCP pins reported `unsupported file type`. I restored the PR file. All three pins passed with `--include-ignored`. The cached-body success pin passed in the same run (60.60 seconds for all three tests).
2. I restored upstream `crates/ui/src/state.rs`. `a_solidcraft_extension_drop_uses_the_model_filter_case_insensitively` failed with exit code 101. It reported `part.solidcraft is not a model file`. I restored the PR file. All three `egui_app::file_drop::tests` passed.

No golden diff required a line-by-line check. The PR changes no dependency, build script, workflow or process file.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: None. The only finding is the missing before/after screenshots of the native Model Open filter.

Screenshot capture is blocked in this session. `screencapture -x` failed with `could not create image from display`. AppKit reports zero screens, no GUI login session, and no screen capture access. I could not capture genuine native-dialog screenshots.

The head is unchanged: e6c93d9d328ea4c762beaac567dc572c8ecc482f. No files, tests, images, labels, or ready state were changed. The quick gate was started and stopped when the screenshot blocker was confirmed. Clippy was not run. No new pin or mutation check applies to this screenshot-only finding.

A session with an active macOS display is needed to capture the images, push them only to the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the PR body. Please re-review after that evidence is added.
